Improves crash diagnosis on Windows and adds debug reports on macOS.

- Prevents overlapping Windows recording sessions when a hotkey reenters during focus lookup or microphone startup. Cancelling during device setup now releases the device without starting a recording. Regression checks reproduce the overlap in the previous implementation.
- Windows preserves crash-monitor history across restarts and records process exit codes, including exits without a crash exception. Debug reports also include recent TalkToMe Application Error metadata from Windows, such as faulting modules and exception codes.
- Adds **Copy debug report** to the Mac result window and **Settings → Diagnostics**, along with **Open diagnostics folder** and **Open macOS crash reports**.
- Mac reports include persistent processing stages and timings, permission status, model selections, and available system crash backtraces. Reports exclude dictated text, prompts, credentials, exception messages and memory/register contents.

The supplied Windows report ended during recording startup without a crash stack. The recording-start bug is fixed, but the exact cause of that reported exit is not yet confirmed. If it recurs, reopen the app and send **Copy debug report** output.

Stable release for Windows x64, Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Windows reuses the existing shared engine download. Mac builds remain ad-hoc signed until Developer ID signing/notarization is configured. Original system crash reports and Windows memory dumps remain local and may contain private data; nothing is uploaded automatically.
